delve/atanya.addendum: In YRT: ordinary cold-adapted seafaring humans; their 'weather-sense' is experience, not mana. The forsaken-god origin is folk legend. If you want flavour, a mild Azure cultural practice (inherited medicinal traditions, topical cold-injury care) fits without changing them biologically.

delve/bladewing.addendum: In YRT: a mundane nocturnal predator with natural echolocation — no mana required. Optional trace Amber in the inner ear for sharper echolocation.

delve/blighthound.addendum: In YRT: a blight-zone apex scavenger. Gestation near Black and Crimson outcroppings produces the charred hide, red ocular fluorescence, horns, and heat-leeching breath. The 'death sense' is smelling decaying Black-exposed tissue at long range — drop the prophecy, keep the beast.

delve/blood-thorn.addendum: In YRT: a carnivorous plant that grew up in a blight zone. Verdant drives the aggressive growth and tendril motion; Azure lets it extract and stitch new pods from prey blood. Green body, red-sheathed thorns, central pod acting as a crude natural seed.

delve/bog-rot.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — a preserved corpse that rises with intent, memory, and the ability to bargain requires a soul, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Mire-Form: a wild Verdant + Black construct using a preserved corpse as a plant-growth substrate. Not the dead person, but a plant using a dead body as a pot. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/bonehorde.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — the 'spiteful being at the heart' is a soul, and YRT has none. Replaced by the War-Pile: a pre-Fall AI construct with centuries-old standing orders, assembling structural mass (bones, scrap metal, masonry) around a Crimson-powered AI core. Reawakens when dragged into sunlight. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/carrion-newt.addendum: In YRT: an ordinary large amphibian. Optional Verdant trace in eggs that incubate in rotting flesh — a Verdant/decay boundary niche.

delve/cave-lion.addendum: In YRT: a mundane big cat. No changes needed.

delve/chitter.addendum: In YRT: a blight-adapted giant insect. Azure drives the scale-up, chitin regeneration, and digestive-slurry vomit; faint Amber the twittering call used for spatial mapping. Grey-brown carapace, yellowish vomit.

delve/circle-of-stones.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — thinking stones that trade knowledge for memory require agency stones don't have. Replaced by the Whispering Stones: a leaking pre-Fall Amber communication relay whose decayed buffer inflicts neural-pattern interference on anyone inside the perimeter. Confusion, false recall, personality drift. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/deep-rat.addendum: In YRT: a mundane naked-mole-rat analogue. No mana required.

delve/glimmer.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — paths descending into the past or climbing into the future require time travel, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Wisp-Walker: a drifting Amber + Luminous particle cloud that lures travellers into blight zones by appearing to guide them. Not a person, not a guide — a feedback loop between the cloud and the observer's own brain. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/gloom.addendum: In YRT: an unbound Amber + Black wild-mana phenomenon in dark, still places — not intelligent, a self-sustaining mana weather system drifting along gradients of warmth and prey. Amber drives the illusions, voice mimicry, and fear induction; Black is the shadow-mass itself and the life-leech on enveloped prey. Oily black with flickering amber edges where it touches minds. The 'mind like a crow picks at carrion' is a description of Amber backlash effects, not malice.

delve/gnarl.addendum: In YRT: a huge forest herbivore symbiotic with Verdant mana. Verdant drives hide pigmentation, seasonal colour shift, longevity, and antler growth; Gray gives the bark-textured dermal layer. Hide shifts green / amber / russet / bare-brown through its life.

delve/husk.addendum: In YRT: the walking worst-case outcome of the mana-backlash oracle — a wizard who over-drew on Black, Amber, and Crimson and survived in a ruined state. 'Forever hungry' is mana addiction. Black for decay and life-leech, Amber for compulsion and extracting mana from others, Crimson for the forbidden attack magic.

delve/iron-wracked-beast.addendum: In YRT: an industrial-era contamination victim. Free Gray mana from a ruptured pre-Fall site converts the animal's tissue into a structural lattice — a slow, agonising transformation. Crimson residue drives the pain, the heat, and the howl. Iron-grey patches in weeping red flesh. The 'hammer on anvil' sound is Gray crystallisation inside muscle tissue. The 'Iron Blight' is a local name for the industrial contamination gradient itself; affected animals cluster near old Conclave refinery ruins.

delve/kraken.addendum: In YRT: a mundane giant cephalopod, just very large. Optional Azure trace for regenerative tissue — it's very hard to kill.

delve/maelstrom.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — a sentient vortex that bargains with the drowning requires agency water doesn't have. Replaced by the Drowning-Eye: a wild mana vortex sustained by ruptured Azure and Luminous seeds from a shipwreck, the 'voices' an Amber imprint on suspended particulates. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/merrow.addendum: In YRT: an aquatic humanoid species — the religion is human culture, not magic. Crude Azure-based rituals (topical healing, endurance) are consistent with any coastal culture.

delve/nightmare-spider.addendum: In YRT: a giant spider. The hallucinogenic venom is biochemistry, not magic. Optional Amber trace in the venom glands — the vivid hallucinations are biochemically indistinguishable from a weak Amber dose.

delve/nightspawn.addendum: In YRT: the definition-perfect blight creature — gestated in or near a contaminated zone. Colour and capability vary by zone: a Black-zone nightspawn leeches life, a Crimson-zone one discharges energy, a mixed-zone one is unpredictable. Roll on a blight-contamination table per individual.

delve/rhaskar.addendum: In YRT: a mundane large arctic predator — a big territorial animal.

delve/shroud-crab.addendum: In YRT: a camouflaging crustacean. Optional trace Gray in the carapace for matter-matching camouflage; otherwise mundane chromatophores.

delve/tempest.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — an intelligent storm that offers bargains requires agency weather doesn't have. Replaced by the Witherwind: a wild Luminous + Azure storm drifting along thermal gradients toward warmth, the 'voices' Amber imprints suspended in the Luminous lattice. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/thrall.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — possession by an undead spirit requires a spirit, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Carrier: a living host with a surgically implanted Amber compulsion-seed at the base of the skull, keyed to a trigger. The puppeteer is a living caster somewhere, not a ghost. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/trog.addendum: In YRT: a burrowing reptilian predator. Luminous trace gives the bioluminescent scale layer; faint Verdant explains longevity and regrowth of claws and scales. Green-white glow.

delve/wight.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — a corpse that retains reasoning and purpose beyond death requires soul persistence, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Tomb-Walker: a living person inside an illegal Gray + Azure life-support rig, sustained past natural death. Mortal, killable, and they know to the day how long their reservoir will last. See the YRT Bestiary.

delve/wyrm.addendum: In YRT: a mundane very large serpent; 'eyes piercing the thickest darkness' is excellent night vision. Optional Verdant-tinted longevity and Crimson trace in the eyes for the torchlight gaze.

delve/zealot.addendum: In YRT: ordinary religious fanatics, entirely human. 'Powers of the faith' are crude stolen or black-market mana seeds — common-use flares, panic wards, or smuggled Crimson seeds from a sympathetic artificer.

ironsworn/basilisk.addendum: In YRT: a giant snake. The 'mesmerising gaze' is either mundane predator stillness or a trace Amber organ behind the eyes — slow, short-range, effective on small prey only.

ironsworn/boar.addendum: In YRT: an oversized aggressive pig. If the size wants explaining, mild Azure in the local environment produces oversized wildlife generally — the same explanation covers elder beasts, gnarls, and mammoths in the same region.

ironsworn/bonewalker.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — animated skeletons with the will to destroy life require a soul, and YRT has none. Replaced by Puppet-Bones: a handler-driven illegal skeletal construct operated remotely via an Amber command-link from up to two hundred paces away. Mindless when the handler quits. See the YRT Bestiary.

ironsworn/broken.addendum: In YRT: humans who have gone feral. If you want a cause, hint at long-term untreated Amber exposure from living on contaminated land — personality erosion matches the backlash description.

ironsworn/chimera.addendum: In YRT: an unstable Verdant + Azure + Black grafting experiment — someone tried to make a living construct from carrion and it kept moving. Azure fuses tissue, Verdant grows and self-repairs, Black tolerates dead material as substrate. It eats, screams, attacks — no higher cognition.

ironsworn/elder-beast.addendum: In YRT: oversized wolves, bears, or boars gestated near a stable long-standing blight zone. Azure drives the size and longevity; trace Crimson gives the red-glowing eyes. The 'avatars of the old gods, long-lived as trees' is folk belief.

ironsworn/elf.addendum: In YRT, called the Verdani — a humanoid species shaped over generations by sustained deep Verdant exposure, historically tied to farms, bio-preserves, and the great mana estates of the pre-scarcity era. Once widespread wherever green mana reservoirs flourished; now rare, holding the remaining preserves they tend. 'Binding animals to aid in defence' is skilled Verdant and Amber use: long-term training reinforced by scent-compulsion seeds. Wooden masks contain Amber-tuning channels. The Conclave dislikes their Mask-Risen practice but has not stopped it.

ironsworn/frostbound.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — cursed dead driven to seek warmth require a curse, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Coldhusk: a Luminous + Azure-saturated corpse in Luminous-rich permafrost, with a thermal-differential reflex to grasp anything warm that comes within reach. Does not pursue. Does not seek. Waits. See the YRT Bestiary.

ironsworn/gaunt.addendum: In YRT: a blight-adapted grazer bred by the Verdani. Gray gives the scaled hide for protection; faint Luminous explains the pale-eye glow. An unusual species, not supernatural.

ironsworn/giant.addendum: In YRT: an unusually tall humanoid species, or a mountain-adapted subculture of humans. If you want biological flavour, regional Azure exposure produces larger humans over generations — same explanation as elder beasts.

ironsworn/harrow-spider.addendum: In YRT: a giant spider — Azure-tinted gigantism, otherwise a normal arachnid. Iridescent black eyes come from trace Amber/Gray in the lens tissue, not functionally magical.

ironsworn/haunt.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — a restless spirit tied to an unjust death requires a spirit, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Echo: an Amber imprint at the site of a violent death, burned onto porous material (stone, old wood, deep snow, standing water). A recording, not a person. Replays when disturbed. See the YRT Bestiary.

ironsworn/hollow.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — a dead Verdani's vengeance given self-assembling form requires soul persistence, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Mask-Risen (and its larger Greatmask variant): a Verdant construct walked by a living Verdani elder via an Amber-laced mask. Kill the mask or stop the walker, not the body. See the YRT Bestiary.

ironsworn/iron-revenant.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — an incorporeal force of vows given metal form requires a soul, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Vow-Walker: a Pura Ecclesia reliquary shell (Luminous armour, Azure joints, Crimson core, ceramic death-mask) operated by an Iron Warden handler via an Amber-encoded oath. Doctrinal necessity, not supernatural. See the YRT Bestiary.

ironsworn/leviathan.addendum: In YRT: an enormous sea beast, mundane megafauna. Optional deep-ocean blight flavour — Azure-tough tissue and Gray-infused dermis; 'flesh as tough as iron' reads literally.

ironsworn/marsh-rat.addendum: In YRT: a large mundane rat.

ironsworn/mystic.addendum: In YRT: a Vizion (Conclave Amber-trained mage) — or an unlicensed one. 'Walks in two worlds' is folk description of a heavy Amber user, and the shimmering eyes are a documented Amber-implant side effect. Amber primary; Luminous + Gray for ward and circle work; some are black-market Black users, which explains 'consumed by the darkness'.

ironsworn/primordial.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — vestigial spirits of forgotten gods require gods, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Locus: a walking mana-saturation point, dominated by a single colour, its body whatever local matter that colour wants to bind. Not sentient, not agentic, just very large and drifting toward higher flux. See the YRT Bestiary.

ironsworn/sodden.addendum: In YRT: does not exist as written — a lonely restless spirit of the drowned requires a spirit, and YRT has none. Replaced by the Bloater: an Azure-saturated corpse in a contaminated water source, with a reflexive spinal response to thermal and pressure stimuli. Grabs, holds, drowns. Not pursuing, not sad, just reactive. See the YRT Bestiary.

ironsworn/troll.addendum: In YRT: a large humanoid with camouflaging skin — the same chromatophore trick as a shroud crab, just bigger. Gray-trace dermal layer; otherwise mundane biology. Solitary, shy, hoards objects.

ironsworn/varou.addendum: In YRT: a wolf-featured humanoid species. The 'bloodcall' reads as Crimson susceptibility — their nervous system reacts to local Crimson mana and blood scent with a rage state. They avoid blight zones for this reason.

ironsworn/warrior.addendum: In YRT: a human with training.

ironsworn/wyvern.addendum: In YRT: a mundane winged flying reptile. The three breeds map to regional mana exposure: tawny (none), verdant (trace Verdant hide, deeper forest), iron (Gray-infused dermal plates — the metallic sheen is literal). None supernatural.
